::: {#exr-sample-llik}
#### Log-likelihood of the dataset

Write down the log-likelihood of the full dataset.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-sample-llik}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\ell(\lambda; \vx)
&\eqdef \logf{\Lik(\lambda; \vx)}
&& \text{(definition of log-likelihood)}\\
&= \logf{\prod_{i = 1}^n \frac{\lambda^{x_i} e^{-\lambda}}{x_i!}}
&& \text{(likelihood of the dataset)}\\
&= \sum_{i = 1}^n \logf{\frac{\lambda^{x_i} e^{-\lambda}}{x_i!}}
&& \text{(log of a product)}\\
&= \sum_{i = 1}^n \paren{\logf{\lambda^{x_i}} + \logf{e^{-\lambda}} - \logf{x_i!}}
&& \text{(log of a product and of a quotient)}\\
&= \sum_{i = 1}^n \paren{x_i \logf{\lambda} - \lambda - \logf{x_i!}}
&& \text{(log of a power; $\log e^{a} = a$)}\\
&= \paren{\sum_{i = 1}^n x_i} \logf{\lambda} - n\lambda - \sum_{i = 1}^n \logf{x_i!}
&& \text{(split the sum)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
